name: Umejima
tagline: Tokyo in 32 minutes and Otemachi in 34 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Adachi City, served by Tobu Skytree Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 34 minutes to Otemachi, 46 minutes to Shinjuku, 56 minutes to Shibuya and 48 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 0.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.1 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 0.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from -0.8 m to 1.3 m, a difference of 2.1 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 3 to 5 m. All nine points within 400 m of the station fall inside the area too, and the deepest projection among them is 5 to 10 m. For storm surge, 9 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the large side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 clinics and 10 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 厚友会足立東部病院, about 12 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 梅田病院, about 12 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tobu Skytree Line.
congestion: Tobu Skytree Line runs at 142% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 小菅→北千住; trains from here toward 北千住 pass through it. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥120,000 to ¥130,000 and 2LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. schools and parks within walking distance pushes the figure up. On the other side, a large projected flood depth and only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down.

neighbours.lead: Nishiarai is ahead on how easy the shopping is, and little else separates the two.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Umejima. Both have the Tobu Skytree Line. Nishiarai also has the Tobu Daishi Line, which Umejima does not. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. On how easy the shopping is, Nishiarai comes out ahead. Within about 13 minutes' walk, Nishiarai has 8 supermarkets (AEON and まいばすけっと and others) and Umejima has 6.

neighbours.lead: Rent, commute and flood projections differ little.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Umejima in a straight line. It is served by the same lines as Umejima. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. Rents, flood projections and the rest differ little.

goodFor: People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People who want another route when service is suspended
noiseSources: The nearest big road, 日光街道, is far enough that little traffic noise reaches the station area

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tobu Skytree Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Tobu Skytree Line trains toward 北千住 pass through the line's busiest stretch, but at 142% passengers are not shoulder to shoulder.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
